description: How an article's questions did in AI answers before and after it went live. For each question it answers (tracked from the article, or holding every word of its target keyword; up to 10, and more counts the rest): the answers in the 4 weeks before it went live and every answer since, how many named or linked you (cited) and how many linked your site (sourceCited). Null until the article is live.
name: get_article_impact
